generate_apis.description: Optional flag that, if set to true will disable the generation of APIs when API Call records are sent

hidden.name: hidden
hidden.description: Select to Hide or unhide the provided Discovered APIs

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Offset item number from list to begin return

search_filter.description: Optional search of Discovered APIs that contain provided values of their properties

sensitivity.name: sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Optional sensitivity for path parameter detection

show_hidden.name: show_hidden
show_hidden.description: Include results of hidden APIs or only return APIs that are not hidden

source.name: source
source.description: Optional source to use to filter Discovered API lists

state.name: state
state.description: Optional state to use to filter Discovered API lists

title.description: Title to be used for generated OpenAPI Document

version.description: Version to be used for generated OpenAPI Document
